A '''log''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds [[Stonecutter]] recipes and [[Leatherworker]] trades for the 22 variants below, and otherwise leaves them as in vanilla. See {{MCW|Log}} for everything else.
